referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The official AV Painting Seattle homepage was inspected in paired desktop and mobile full-page captures. The page opens with a wide dusk house photograph carries centered white service copy and a green estimate button. It uses cream logo strip over dark horizontal service navigation with a green appointment block. The visual system relies on clear sans headings with warm gold accents and measured body copy; surfaces include white, soft gray, charcoal and accents include forest green, muted gold. Imagery is finished residential exteriors, preparation close-ups, and lived-in rooms. The page then runs through house-photo hero, split local-company introduction, tabbed exterior and interior showcase, three-step preparation process, financing image feature, three reasons to choose, residential case photo, review and footer. Its service presentation is photo-led service selector with vertical tabs for exterior, interior, and cabinet work. Mobile changes to stack the tabs as labeled service choices, preserve the house image, and keep estimate prompts after each major decision point. Transfer only the layout rhythm and decision path. Do not copy AV Painting branding, home photos, warranty term, financing claims, customer quotes, awards, or certification marks.

acceptanceChecks: The opening accurately names the client's verified painting contractor scope and presents an immediate next action.
The service, process, proof, and contact chapters follow the reference's observed decision rhythm without copying its identity.
